title: Issue #4: Build Persona Persistence Layer (memory graph)
instructions:
Build packages/core/memory/ with:
1. SQLite schema using better-sqlite3 — tables: entities, relationships, context_notes
2. MemoryGraph class with remember(note: string), recall(topic: string), extractEntities(text: string) — regex/keyword matching only, no LLM call
3. In serve_mist.js chat handler, run extractEntities(userMessage) each turn and inject compact context block into system prompt
4. Expose mist.remember and mist.recall as the first two MISTTools (bridges into Issue #2)
5. Skip Supabase sync — local SQLite only, offline-first
Storage path: workspace/mist-memory.db
Branch: mist/work → commit → push → merge to main
Reference: https://github.com/Mellowambiences/clawd/issues/4

title: Issue #2: Build MISTTool plugin interface and registry
instructions:
Build packages/core/tools/ with:
1. MISTTool interface and MISTToolResult type as defined in the issue
2. mistToolRegistry singleton — register(), list(), execute()
3. toGeminiFunctionSpec() — serializes registered tools into Gemini function-calling format (build even though Gemini is inactive)
4. First tool: weather.current via Open-Meteo (no API key needed)
5. Second + third tools: mist.remember and mist.recall — import from memory graph built in Issue #4
6. In serve_mist.js chat handler: if tool name appears in LLM response, call mistToolRegistry.execute() and append result to next turn
Do Issue #4 FIRST before this one.
Branch: mist/work → commit → push → merge to main
Reference: https://github.com/Mellowambiences/clawd/issues/2
